path.id: Two Decades of Turning Vision Into Reality
Go behind the masterfully orchestrated sets and explore our journey as India's premier production house, built on absolute technical precision and high-art design.

Our founder, Hamsa, began this monumental journey in 2006 from his family home in Bangalore. Equipped with a small analog light desk, a few metal PAR cans, and a single portable diesel generator, he set out to light up local community stages.

In those early days, every event was a hands-on masterclass in resourcefulness. Hamsa hand-soldered connections and rigged structures himself, establishing a culture of absolute technical ownership that continues to drive the crew today.

Recognizing the rapid modernization of Indian weddings and corporate summits, we expanded our specialized services into heavy-duty professional lighting grids and high-capacity silent power distribution.

This was the year Hamsalekha gained a reputation for zero-fail electrical layouts, earning residency partnerships across prominent convention grounds in South India by introducing automatic power switchovers and high-luminance spotlights.
To truly dominate premium event production, we integrated heavy aluminum trussing, complex rigging mechanics, and custom signature stages into our owned inventory.

No longer just lighting up other people's stages, we started engineering the physical environments ourselves. This era gave birth to our highly sought-after custom structures and premium lounge installations.

When COVID-19 brought the live industry to a sudden halt, we refused to stand idle. We utilized this time to overhaul our equipment protocols, retrain our entire crew, and invest heavily in advanced 3D visual pre-visualization software.
We emerged with a renewed operational focus, allowing planners to walk through fully rendered digital sets before a single bolt was laid.
As large-scale events roared back, we expanded our central Bangalore warehouse and grew our core technical crew to over 50 permanently employed rigging, power, and lighting specialists.
Hamsalekha is now recognized as Bangaloreâ€™s premier, standard-setting production house, combining heavy state-of-the-art technical inventory with an artist's vision.

We do not simply place lights or connect generators. We design the unseen nervous system of an experience. When the crowd gasps at the first light reveal, that is the union of heavy-duty engineering and artistic mastery.
Hamsa continues to personally oversee technical design plans for every monumental wedding and high-security state summit, ensuring his high standards of execution remain unchallenged.
Every load calculation is verified down to the millimeter. We operate with standard-certified safety protocols to handle complex truss distributions.
We provide continuous, double-redundancy power solutions. Our silent generators switch instantly, ensuring monumental moments never fade.
We fuse theatrical luminance with floral, tadelakt, and glass structures to construct immersive landscapes tailored to your design expectations.
From Hamsa to our newest rigger, we take complete pride in executing spotless, safe, and elite environments from concept to wrap-up.
Partner with India's premier technical event production team. Get in touch to discuss your grand concept, structural needs, or layout layouts.
Crafting extraordinary events since 2006. Premium lighting, power, and production.
